description: A React component implementing a user signup page for Mattermost, handling form inputs, external sign-in options, invite handling, and UI rendering.

classes.name: Signup
classes.description: React component for user signup page, managing form state, external sign-in options, invite handling, and UI rendering.

methods.name: getExternalSignupOptions
methods.description: Generates external sign-in options based on configuration and license status.

methods.name: handleHeaderBackButtonOnClick
methods.description: Handles back button click to navigate to previous page.

methods.name: handleInvalidInvite
methods.description: Handles invalid invite errors, setting server error messages.

methods.name: handleAddUserToTeamFromInvite
methods.description: Adds user to team from invite token and handles navigation.

methods.name: getInviteInfo
methods.description: Fetches invite info and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: getAlternateLink
methods.description: Returns alternate link component for existing users.

methods.name: onWindowResize
methods.description: Throttled handler for window resize to update mobile view state.

methods.name: desktopExternalAuth
methods.description: Handles external auth link clicks in desktop app context.

methods.name: handleBrandImageError
methods.description: Handles error loading brand image.

methods.name: getCardTitle
methods.description: Determines the card title based on configuration.

methods.name: getMessageSubtitle
methods.description: Returns the subtitle message component.

methods.name: handleEmailOnChange
methods.description: Updates email state on input change.

methods.name: handleNameOnChange
methods.description: Updates username state on input change.

methods.name: handlePasswordInputOnChange
methods.description: Updates password state on input change.

methods.name: handleSignupSuccess
methods.description: Handles post-signup login and redirection.

methods.name: postSignupSuccess
methods.description: Completes signup process, loads user data, and redirects.

methods.name: isUserValid
methods.description: Validates user input fields before submission.

methods.name: dismissAlert
methods.description: Clears alert banner messages.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, user creation, and error handling.

methods.name: handleReturnButtonOnClick
methods.description: Handles return button click to navigate back.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Renders the main signup form and related UI components.
